title: RunResult
description: Output contract: one result row per run, single-line JSON (pd.read_json(lines=True)-friendly). Mirrors clustering.benchmark.metrics.RunResult (Scala). Fields are grouped into CORE (engine-neutral - every engine MUST emit) and ENGINE METRICS (only counters BOTH engines measure on the same basis - see contract/README.md for the cross-engine mapping). Fields Spark and Flink cannot measure identically were removed from the contract rather than emitted as an always-null placeholder.

errorMessage.description: CORE. Present/non-null only when status='failed'. Omitted when None.

datasetMetadata.description: CORE. e.g. format, nFeatures, numPoints, seed, numPartitions.

sparkConf.description: CORE (engine config echo). Spark emits this key today; Flink MAY emit 'engineConf' instead.

engineConf.description: CORE (neutral alias of sparkConf). Either key is accepted by analysis.

nFeatures.description: CORE. Feature dimensionality. Omitted when unknown.

phaseDurationsMs.description: ENGINE. Wall clock per phase, keyed by phase name ('load'|'fit'|'eval'). Sums to totalDurationMs up to the boundary settles and the post-eval teardown, which belongs to no phase.

phaseCpuTimeNs.description: ENGINE. Worker process CPU per phase — CPU burnt by the worker JVMs while the driver was inside that phase (see the engines' snapshot docs). Same definition on both engines; sums to executorCpuTimeNs minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseGcTimeMs.description: ENGINE. Whole-JVM GC time per phase, summed across workers. Sums to jvmGcTimeMs minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseMemoryGbHours.description: ENGINE. Heap-used time-integral per phase, in GB-hours. Sums to memoryGbHours minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseDriverCpuTimeNs.description: ENGINE. Driver/JobManager process CPU per phase — where the driver-local phases of PAM/CLARA/dbscanpp show up. Sums to driverCpuTimeNs minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseDriverGcTimeMs.description: ENGINE. Whole-JVM GC time of the driver/JobManager process per phase. Sums to driverGcTimeMs minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseDriverMemoryGbHours.description: ENGINE. Heap-used time-integral of the driver/JobManager process per phase, in GB-hours. Sums to driverMemoryGbHours minus the post-eval teardown (cache unpersist + shutdown), which is deliberately charged to no phase so that every phase's accumulators and its phaseDurationsMs describe the SAME window.

phaseWindowPeakExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: MAX over workers of that worker's heap peak while the driver was inside the phase. Gap-free within the phase — every worker's sampler reads the JVM's tracked peak and RESETS it each tick, so a spike between two ticks still sets that tick's record and the ticks tile the phase. Residual imprecision is attribution only: the tick straddling a boundary counts wholly towards one phase. Answers 'which phase drove the run's memory'.

phaseWindowTotalExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: SUM over workers of each worker's heap peak = cluster footprint during that phase.

phaseWindowPeakDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: MAX over workers of DIRECT (off-heap NIO) buffer memory. Unlike the heap version this one is genuinely SAMPLED at the reporting period (200ms) and a sub-tick spike can be missed: buffer pools expose only a current reading — no peak, no reset — on both engines, so this is the one and only kind of direct peak available.

phaseWindowTotalDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: SUM over workers of each worker's sampled direct-memory reading.

phaseWindowDriverPeakHeapBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: heap peak of the driver/JobManager process, gap-free within the phase like the worker one — where a driver-local phase (PAM, CLARA seeding, dbscanpp union-find) shows its RAM appetite.

phaseWindowDriverPeakDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Per phase: sampled direct-memory peak of the driver/JobManager process (sampled, like every direct figure).

jvmGcTimeMs.description: ENGINE. JVM GC time across workers (or 0).

executorCpuTimeNs.description: ENGINE. Aggregate worker process CPU time, ns (or 0).

avgCpuCoresBusy.description: ENGINE. executorCpuTimeNs / (totalDurationMs * 1e6) = avg cores busy over the run. Omitted when duration <= 0.

cpuCoreHours.description: ENGINE. executorCpuTimeNs / 3.6e12 = worker CPU burnt, in core-hours — the unit the PLGrid grant is billed in.

peakExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Peak per-worker JVM heap, MAX of a single worker (or 0).

totalExecutorMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. SUM of per-worker heap peaks = cluster memory footprint (or 0).

memoryGbHours.description: ENGINE. Time-integral (Riemann sum, at the sampling period, 200ms by default) of heap used across workers, in GB-hours: total RAM actually CONSUMED over the run, as opposed to totalExecutorMemoryBytes' peak snapshot.

peakDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Peak per-worker DIRECT (off-heap NIO) buffer memory, MAX of a single worker (or 0). Netty shuffle/network buffers on both engines live here, invisible to peakExecutorMemoryBytes. No JVM-tracked peak API exists for buffer pools (unlike heap), so this is a max-of-samples at the sampling period (200ms by default) on both engines — a shared, symmetric limitation, not a Spark-only gap.

totalDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. SUM of per-worker direct-memory peaks = cluster off-heap footprint (or 0).

driverCpuTimeNs.description: ENGINE. Driver process CPU, ns. Spark: the driver JVM. Flink: the JobManager process, meaningful only under standalone Application Mode (standalone-job.sh) where it runs the driver-local algorithm code; under session-mode `flink run` it reads ~0. Separate from executorCpuTimeNs on purpose; in local mode it is the SAME process, so do not sum them.

driverPeakHeapBytes.description: ENGINE. Peak JVM heap used by the driver/JobManager process (or 0).

driverGcTimeMs.description: ENGINE. Whole-JVM GC time of the driver/JobManager process (or 0).

driverMemoryGbHours.description: ENGINE. Time-integral of heap used by the driver/JobManager process, in GB-hours.

driverPeakDirectMemoryBytes.description: ENGINE. Peak DIRECT (off-heap NIO) buffer memory used by the driver/JobManager process (or 0).

nClusters.description: CORE. Number of non-noise clusters found. Omitted when 'nClusters' not requested in EvaluationSpec.metrics.

noiseFraction.description: CORE. Fraction labelled noise (label -1). Omitted when 'noiseFraction' not requested.

silhouette.description: CORE. Silhouette score, possibly subsampled. Read it next to noiseFraction (a run reports the silhouette of the CLUSTERED points only, so a density method is rewarded for discarding hard ones) and next to the three silhouetteS* counters below, which say what the sample actually contained. Omitted when not computed.

silhouetteScoredPoints.description: CORE. Drawn points the silhouette actually scored — the ACHIEVED sample size, Binomial around evaluation.sampleSize rather than equal to it. Present exactly when 'silhouette' is.

silhouetteSampleClusters.description: CORE. Distinct clusters present in the silhouette's sample. Below nClusters means whole clusters missed the draw, so b was minimised over the survivors only and the score reads HIGH. Present exactly when 'silhouette' is.

silhouetteUnscoredPoints.description: CORE. Drawn points the silhouette refused: a non-finite coordinate or weight, or a cluster that drew fewer than two sample members (its a is unestimable, so the point is excluded rather than scored 0). Large values mean the score describes a smaller population than the draw intended. Present exactly when 'silhouette' is.

clusterSizes.description: CORE. clusterId(string) -> size. Omitted when 'clusterSizes' not requested.

daviesBouldin.description: CORE. Davies-Bouldin index, always on the FULL data (linear in n, so never sampled). LOWER is better, 0 is the floor. Omitted when 'daviesBouldin' not requested.

calinskiHarabasz.description: CORE. Calinski-Harabasz (variance-ratio) index, always on the FULL data. HIGHER is better and unbounded, so it only ranks labellings of the SAME dataset. Omitted when 'calinskiHarabasz' not requested.
